title.value: GFlowOut: Dropout with Generative Flow Networks
title.justification: The title 'GFlowOut: Dropout with Generative Flow Networks' reflects the main subject of the paper, which introduces a new method called GFlowOut that uses Generative Flow Networks for generating dropout masks.
title.quote: GFlowOut: Dropout with Generative Flow Networks

extractions.description: The paper proposes GFlowOut, a novel method using Generative Flow Networks to learn the distribution of dropout masks in neural networks. It addresses issues in traditional Bayesian deep learning methods regarding uncertainty estimation and scalability. The method is tested on tasks like uncertainty estimation, distribution shift robustness, and transfer learning, with applications in clinical datasets.
